description: A global dataset of onshore wind turbines with site-specific historical (1989–2018) and future (2030–2059) wind resources across 89 countries is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Christopher Jung et al. The expansion of wind energy is a key strategy for mitigating global climate change. To support this goal, consistent global-scale datasets of existing wind turbines can inform planning for the future deployment of wind energy. Here, we introduce GOWIRES, a global dataset of onshore wind turbines. GOWIRES provides detailed information on 416,417 horizontal-axis wind turbines (HAWT) across 89 countries. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, Excel, Shapefile, GeoPackage. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
